page.layout: Two columns of author names, left column then right column. Above both, the running head "AVT. NOMINA:". A curly brace stands below the right column, with no text beside it.
page.notes: The names are printed in two columns, with the right-hand column's last line, "Ptolemæus", set indented. Several names run over a line end without a printed hyphen, so they are written whole: Stridonensis, Polutianus, Scafnaburgensis, Ticinensis, Sabellicus, Vuestmonasterius, Illyricus, Narbonensis, Premonstratensis. Uncertain readings: "Abbas" (Ioachim) and "Funccius" are marked [?]. The letter forms in "Riuius" and "Triuetus" are as printed. The curly brace below the right column has no text beside it and is not transcribed. No page number is printed.
